notes.title: Update 1 out now
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30687458/de0a5f21299228f76d1b6a1d6df44399ff97bc0e.png[/img]
[b]Summary:[/b]
	-Improved movement system
	-New team skins for ai
	-Improved bots
	-Ability descriptions

[b]Changes:[/b]
	AI
	-Modified the ai behaviour to chase more
	-Heavies weapon range reduced by 25%
	-Reduced laser bots laser beam duration to 0.15 seconds (from 0.25)
	-Heavies weapon rate of fire reduced by 33%

	GRAPHICS
	-Laser bots beams are now the colour of their team
	-Laser bots now have a team colour paint job
	-Heavies now have a team colour paint job
	
	CORE DEFENSE
	-Increased Core Defense difficulty (heavy health increase and possibility of having a heavies wave increased)
	-Added heavies to wave 1 of Core Defense

	MOVEMENT
	-Reduced riggers and Inquisitors base turning and fall speed
	-Reduced Lancers fall speed
	-Increased Raptors turning speed
	-Set default turning rate in the options menu to -0.8
	-Reduced turning rate while falling for all skimmerz
	-Increased Lancer boost to 5 seconds
        -Increased range of turning sensitivity.
        -Removed turning drift
        -Turning sensitivity is now consistent.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
	SKIMMERZ
	-Rigger gun not working properly while charge pulse is active
	-Adjusted center of mass for all skimmerz to reduce flipping
        -Turning on terrain unpredictable.

	AI
	-Heavies clipping through walls

[b]Additions:[/b]
	-Additional tutorial text "4 points are awarded for your destruction"
	-Skimmer information on new game selection
